segments.text: BREZZA IS BACK: But is the base model the secret to unlocking the ultimate driving experience? The answer might just surprise you!
Under the hood, the Brezza packs a punch with 109 hp of power - perfect for zipping through city streets and cruising down highways.
And with 170 nm of torque, this compact SUV has the muscle to handle your daily adventures with ease and confidence.
The best part? You get a great balance of features like a turbo-petrol engine and more, all starting from the base model - talk about a smart buy!
Maruti's all-in on performance and premiumisation - but can the Brezza really reclaim its throne? The plot thickens...
Brezza or Nexon - which team are you on? Let us know in the comments! Don't forget to like, share, and subscribe for the latest updates!
